candidates.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
candidates.summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

candidates.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
candidates.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

candidates.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
candidates.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.

candidates.title: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore returns a synthesized, source-cited answer to a natural-language question in a single tool call, with no search, retrieve, synthesize, and citation pipeline to build. Learn how it works and how to add it to an AgentCore Gateway and call it from an agent.

candidates.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
candidates.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

candidates.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
candidates.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

candidates.title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI
candidates.summary: Learn how Amazon Marketplace evaluates A+ Content quality at scale on Amazon SageMaker AI by rendering each product page as a single snapshot, scoring it with a vision-language model fused with OCR readability signals in a CatBoost classifier, and using SHAP to turn each decision into prioritized, actionable recommendations for selling partners.
